notes.title: Update 0.10.0
notes.notes:
We are excited to push this new update! What's new?

[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]option to smooth the wave to make it cleaner. You can turn off this option if your device is not powerful enough,
[*]better whitewash effect behind the wave and on the shore. Make sure to turn the 'foam' quality level in the settings,
[*]better environment rendering of the ocean bottom, ocean depth and horizon,
[*]shorten the time to paddle before the wave breaks,
[*]better rendering of the flat and hollow sections.
[*]spits are back!
[/list]

[h1]Player Profiles[/h1]
[list]
[*]click the name of a player in a leaderboard to open his/her profile,
[*]click your name in the top bar to see your profile,
[*]the profile player window shows the XP progression, season ranking, and all trophies earned.
[/list]

Don't forget to report any bug or ideas to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8GRFtWR]Discord[/url].

NEVER STOP RIDING

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
You can now view the global leaderboards for:
[list]
[*]XP level
[*]multiplayer rating
[/list]
These leaderboards are updated once a day. You also have the possibility to find yourself in the ranking if you are not in the top 10!

[h1]Training[/h1]
We've added the possibility to train for a maneuver: it will bring you to a practice wave and show your timing for that maneuver while you are riding the wave. This will help you understand how the timing works and where is the best section to hit each maneuver!

[h1]Media Capture[/h1]
We are partnering with [url=https://omnislash.com/game/youriding]Omnislash[/url] to bring advancement screenshots capabilities: the system will automatically take screenshots when you hit perfect timing maneuvers and when you are in the barrel while using POV or inside the barrel cameras.
You can find more information about it by following this [url=https://youriding.gg/omnislash]link[/url].

[h1]Bug fixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]back button not working while playing multiplayer
[*]possibility to turn off the XP earning animation and sound after a wave (in the settings under Sounds and Effects)
[*]wave editor: prevent publishing a wave without making any changes to it or if the name already exists.
[/list]

Don't forget to report any bug or ideas to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8GRFtWR]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Update 0.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]XP Progression[/h1]
You can now earn XP by riding waves. Score 1,000 points to get 1 XP. Once you reach the XP target you will level up and move up in categories every 10 levels. XP levels will soon be used to unlock equipment in the shop.
Can you make it to the G.O.A.T. status?

[i]Tip: play in multiplayer mode to get a X3 XP bonus and progress faster![/i]

[h1]Offline mode[/h1]
We've added the possibility to play offline. You can still play in freeride mode without any internet access and it will save your scores locally, then store it online as soon as your connection is back. You will earn the XP related to these rides once it's saved online.

[h1]Bug fixes and improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]sign in issues
[*]cannot take off the t-shirt in the shop
[*]graphics improvements
[*]better rider's trail
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.0.20
notes.notes:
Boards are now giving you attributes that change how you ride the wave. There are 5 attributes:
[list]
[*]Top speed: Changes how fast you can go. Going very fast can help you make difficult sections in the barrel.
[*]Speed control: This helps you having a better control over your speed by stalling and accelerating faster.
[*]Handling: A good handling will help you change direction faster and potentially be more precise in your timing.
[*]Balance: This attribute will make you lose less balance in the barrel and recover your balance faster.
[*]Maneuver: Thanks to this attribute you will lose less balance and speed when doing maneuvers.
[/list]

Other improvements:
[list]
[*]Bug fix: spot placement on the map not accurate on some screens.
[*]Bug fix: iOS: big empty margin at the bottom of the screen
[/list]

Next update will have some physics fixes and improvements, then we will implement the progression system!

The iOS version is currently in private BETA, contact us to get access to it!

Don't forget to report any bug or ideas to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/8GRFtWR]Discord[/url].
